# Denton Plumbing Pros

> Comprehensive Local Plumbing Referral and Emergency Service Platform in Denton, Texas.

## Organization Details
- **Name:** Denton Plumbing Pros
- **Primary Service Area:** Denton, TX and Denton County (76201, 76205, 76207, 76208, 76209, 76210, 76226, 76249)
- **Surrounding Municipalities:** Corinth, TX; Argyle, TX; Little Elm, TX; Lake Dallas, TX; Sanger, TX; Aubrey, TX; Highland Village, TX
- **Phone:** (940) 310-4499
- **Operating Hours:** 24 Hours / 7 Days a Week (Emergency Dispatch Active)
- **Website:** https://dentonplumbingpros.com

## Primary Service Categories
- **Emergency Plumbing:** 24/7 priority dispatch for frozen burst pipes, overflowing toilets, ceiling leaks, and raw sewage backups.
- **Water Heater Repair & Installation:** Tank and tankless water heater diagnostics, sacrificial anode replacement, calcium descaling, and high-efficiency replacements (Navien, Rheem, Bradford White).
- **Drain Cleaning & Hydro-Jetting:** 4000 PSI high-pressure water jetting, motorized auger snaking, and fiber-optic sewer camera inspection for kitchen, bathroom, and main lateral clogs.
- **Slab Leak Detection & Repair:** Electronic acoustic listening discs, thermal infrared imaging, line isolation pressure testing, and direct foundation bypass / PEX rerouting for North Texas expansive clay soil shifts.
- **Sewer Line Repair & Relining:** Trenchless pipe relining, root removal, and cast iron / PVC replacement.
- **Whole-Home Repiping:** Corrosion-resistant PEX-A water line retrofits for older galvanized or slab-embedded copper plumbing.

## Local Geological & Water Quality Context
- **Soil Type:** High-plasticity Houston Black Clay soil subject to severe seasonal volumetric expansion and contraction, which stresses underground slab plumbing lines.
- **Water Hardness:** 7–10 Grains Per Gallon (GPG) / ~150 mg/L mineral hardness from Lake Ray Roberts and Lake Lewisville surface reservoirs, causing rapid sediment calcification in water heaters.
